title: Setmelanotide Injection
overview: Setmelanotide injection is used to lose weight and then to keep from gaining back that weight in certain adults and children 6 years of age or older who are obese due to certain inherited conditions including proopiomelanocortin (POMC), proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 1 (PCSK1), or leptin receptor (LEPR) deficiency (inherited conditions that cause severe obesity) or Bardet-Biedl syndrome (BBS; an inherited condition that can cause severe obesity). Setmelanotide is in a class of medications called melanocortin 4 (MC4) receptor agonists. It works by activating pathways in the brain to promote weight loss by decreasing appetite and caloric intake, and increasing energy expenditure.

sections.Before using setmelanotide injection,: tell your doctor and pharmacist if you are allergic to setmelanotide, any other medications, benzyl alcohol, or any of the ingredients in setmelanotide injection. Ask your pharmacist for a list of the ingredients.tell your doctor and pharmacist what other prescription and nonprescription medications, vitamins, nutritional supplements, and herbal products you are taking or plan to take. Your doctor may need to change the doses of your medications or monitor you carefully for side effects.tell your doctor if you have or have ever had depression, mood problems, suicidal thoughts or behavior; areas of darkened or discolored skin; or kidney problems.tell your doctor if you are pregnant or plan to become pregnant. If you become pregnant while using setmelanotide injection, call your doctor.tell your doctor if you are breast-feeding. You should not breastfeed while you are using setmelanotide injection.you should know that your mental health may change in unexpected ways, and you may become suicidal (think about harming or killing yourself or plan or try to do so) while you are using setmelanotide injection. You, your family, or your caregiver should call your doctor right away if you experience any of the following symptoms: difficulty falling asleep or staying asleep, impulsive and dangerous behavior, panic attacks, anxiety, agitation, hostility, mania (frenzied, abnormally excited mood), talking or thinking about wanting to hurt yourself or end your life, withdrawing from friends and family, new or worsening depression, preoccupation with death and dying, or giving away prized possessions. Be sure that your family or caregiver knows which symptoms may be serious so they can call the doctor if you are unable to seek treatment on your own.you should know that setmelanotide injection may temporarily increase the pigmentation in your skin and cause darkening of your skin and moles. Tell your doctor if areas or your skin darken or if you have moles that change color or darken. Your doctor will check your skin before starting your treatment and during your treatment with setmelanotide injection.
